text: Great concept for daily general knowledge, but the paywall hits right after the first sample lesson and the subscription price is too expensive if you just want to study with friends.
The free tier is very restricted. You cannot read more than one daily module without a paid subscription upgrade to premium.
Love the 10-minute history and philosophy lessons, but I wish there was a free version without subscription paywalls and a way to share streaks with friends.
Some localized Italian and Romanian texts had awkward machine translation phrasing before the recent update. Also needs an option to write personal notes on each lesson.
Would love offline reading mode and a web version or desktop app so I can read courses on my laptop without losing my sync.
Clean UI and the end-of-lesson quiz is great for memory. Please add a way to collaborate or compare daily streaks with multiple users and friends.
Why can't I customize the reader theme to sepia or dark mode and export my saved notes? The subscription cost is not worth it for a solo reader.
